name: MKE-PLLM
description: A benchmark for multilingual knowledge editing on pretrained large language models, addressing linguistic and knowledge bias through two subdatasets: one with multiple multilingual knowledge editing datasets and another with different language versions of specific knowledge.
reputation: A niche but relevant benchmark in multilingual knowledge editing research, used to study cross-lingual editing and language bias rather than as a broad community standard.
notes: Includes two subdatasets focusing on multilingual knowledge editing and different language versions of knowledge; investigates linguistic and knowledge bias.
